candidates.change_summary: Change logical OR to logical AND so supportsInterface returns true only if both interfaceId == IAccessControl and super.supportsInterface(interfaceId) are true.
Invert the comparison so supportsInterface returns true when interfaceId is NOT IAccessControl or when super supports it.
Always return the result of super.supportsInterface(interfaceId), removing the direct IAccessControl check.
Always return true unconditionally for any interfaceId.
Always return false unconditionally for any interfaceId.
Change return expression to invert stored boolean so hasRole returns the negation of the stored membership.
Always return true regardless of stored membership.
Always return false regardless of stored membership.
Return membership of the zero address instead of the provided account (uses role's mapping for address(0)).
Return membership of the caller (_msgSender()) instead of the provided account.
